name: Manager Escalation - Deadline Email
description: Flowise flow to parse a manager instruction, collect overdue trainees by deadline, build an escalation email, and trigger the app API to send it.

data.title: Manager Instruction
data.placeholder: Example: Escalate trainees who haven't completed by 2026-05-25

data.system: Extract an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the manager instruction. Return JSON: {"deadline":"YYYY-MM-DD"|null, "notes":"..."}. If no date found, set deadline to null.

data.notes: If this route is not present, create `/api/manager/trainees` that returns JSON array of trainees with completedModules and scores with timestamps. For dev testing you may call /api/modules and adapt the evaluate node.

data.system: Given a list of trainees and a deadline, identify trainees not completed by the deadline and list any scores submitted after the deadline. Return JSON: {"overdueTrainees": [...], "scoresAfterDeadline": [...] }
Compose a concise escalation email to the manager's manager with subject and body. Use the lists of overdue trainees and scores after deadline. Return JSON: {"subject": "...", "body": "..." }

data.notes: This endpoint accepts the flowise proxy API key. Set `FLOWISE_PROXY_KEY` in Flowise environment.

metadata.notes: Replace HTTP URLs with your deployed app URL. Provide FLOWISE_MANAGER_API_KEY in Flowise environment variables (or change Authorization header to use cookie/session).
recommended: Add server endpoint: POST /api/manager/flowise/proxy that accepts a flowise API key and triggers the same logic server-side (safer than giving full manager account credentials to Flowise).
Add GET /api/manager/trainees that returns structured trainee progress for easier evaluation in Flowise.
